label: Phrasal verb
examples: I keep ==putting off== my IELTS registration.
Don't ==put off== until tomorrow what you can do today.
The meeting was ==put off== to next week.

meta.caption:
"Put off" ne demek? ⏳

Ertelemek! Türkçede "sonraya bırakmak" dediğimiz her yerde kullanabilirsin:
• I keep putting off my IELTS registration.
• Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today.

Sen en çok neyi erteliyorsun? 😅 Yorumlara yaz 👇
Kaydet, phrasal verb listene ekle 🔖

Phrasal verb of the day: put off = postpone.
